upstair.explanation: Original: keys '<', Esc, Esc, 'r', 'd' (Danger Level 4.1). The game climbs to depth 9, the Borg arrives on a down staircase at (59,28), then reads a Phase Door there and lands at (63,36), off the staircase, with 4 scrolls left. Corrected: only '<' is queued; the Borg arrives at (59,28) on the staircase with all 5 scrolls.

antisummon.label: Up staircase, phase blocked by a recent anti-summon spot
antisummon.explanation: Original: '<' is queued by the stair check, the phase is refused by the anti-summon timer, and the routine goes on to Danger Level 4.2 and queues a Teleportation read after the '<'. The game climbs and the Borg reads Teleportation on the new level (2 to 1 scrolls). Corrected: the stair escape is final; only '<' is queued and no scroll is read.
